scope: Independent actual case-body, intended-contract, source-path, fixture, bounds and semantic-uniqueness review. Only syntax/hash/metadata checks executed.
duplicate_review: No matching semantic design in baseline or concurrent waves. F002 redirect resolution and other routing helpers use URL incidentally; U201 directly checks constructor base-object semantics and fixed components. URLSearchParams/URLPattern mechanisms are otherwise absent. Similar iterator concepts in Headers use a distinct API contract and implementation, not copied test bodies.

execution_contract.route: Actual direct-celld Worker fetch imports local cases; route regex avoids the URL API under test.
execution_contract.documented_cli_source: dev.rs:330-346 accepts a Wrangler config and loopback host/port/no-watch.

case_verdicts.reason: Base URL object and hierarchical resolution, unchanged source URL.
Literal path data encoding; source setter currently copies raw characters.
IDNA/case hostname canonicalization; source setter currently copies raw hostname.
Bracket-aware IPv6 replacement; source currently splits first colon.
Numeric port canonicalization before default elision; source preserves leading zeros.
Existing query object and iterator track href replacement and subsequent append.
Preserve empty-present delimiters across unrelated mutation; source loses presence state.
Opaque blob serialization during mutation; source reconstructs all schemes with authority slashes.
Valid form parsing with plus, first equals, duplicate keys and empty-value distinction.
Form-specific escaping and valid Unicode roundtrip.
Set preserves first duplicate position, removes later duplicates and updates owning URL.
Value-specific membership/removal including empty-string values.
Stable UTF-16 query sort with owning-URL encoding normalization.
Pair iterator rechecks a grown list after earlier done; source generator latches completion.
Pair iteration returns detached arrays; source currently yields internal arrays.
Constructor iterable priority and detached input/copy tuples.
URLPattern base canonicalization and retention of original exec input arguments.
Optional capture own-property shape and independently allocated result groups.
ignoreCase across constrained components while captured case remains input-derived.
Custom regexp capture plus all-component conjunction and hasRegExpGroups.

normative_review.conclusion: Intended URL, URLPattern and Web IDL contracts support the fixed positive oracles. Correct oracles are retained when pinned source disagrees. Source-gap hypotheses are not executed failures.
normative_review.review_correction: U214 originally assumed permanent iterator exhaustion. Corrected to the Web IDL current-list recheck before acceptance; expected failure is now explicitly predicted from generator source.

qualifications: No celld binary, build, case execution, reference-runtime comparison or deployment took place.
A source-based predicted failure must still run unchanged; prediction is not a skip or inverted pass oracle.
No included supervisor enforces the deferred envelope yet. Synchronous API hangs require the documented external deadline.
Claims cover this reviewed corpus, not absent private WPT/conformance suites.
